payload.core_mechanism_summary: Maintains a 26x26 DP table f[last][first] storing max dynasty length. For each name, extends chains where previous last equals current first, updating f[new_last][first]. Also starts new single-name dynasty.
payload.rationale: The DP uses a two-dimensional state indexed by start and end characters, fitting dp_2d_state. The nested loops over characters confirm it's not 1D or tree/memoized.
